capabilities: Preview the converted note as an X Article
Upload vault, embedded and online images to the draft
Crop a 5:2 cover image from an article or local image
Save the note as an X Article draft through Chrome
Continue an interrupted save in the same dialog
disambiguation: Not a general publishing tool; it only saves drafts to X Articles, which you publish yourself.
extras: Free and open source; needs no X Developer API key or AI service. Desktop only, mobile unsupported. The interface is currently in Chinese. The plugin depends on X's website and may need updates when X changes its interface.
problem: Getting a Markdown note into X Articles means copying the text and re-uploading images by hand.

relations.evidence: The plugin launches your locally installed Playwright MCP to connect to Chrome.
connects to your regular Chrome profile and uses its signed-in X account

requires.name: X account with permission to create Articles

summary: Obsidian plugin that previews a note as an X Article and saves it as a draft through a connected Chrome session.
